name: What's the difference between placing a tiny home on a foundation vs. wheels?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between placing a tiny home on a foundation vs. wheels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Placing a tiny home on a foundation typically classifies it as a permanent dwelling or an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU), subject to local building codes for traditional homes. This offers stability and can increase property value. A tiny home on wheels is often classified as a recreational vehicle (RV) and is subject to RV regulations, which vary significantly by municipality regarding permanent residency. Foundation homes usually require more extensive permitting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Foundation tiny homes are permanent dwellings with stricter codes, while tiny homes on wheels are often classified as RVs with different regulations.
